```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
last_season <- 2025L # the 2026 season is still being played
tier_order <- c("Power", "Group of 5", "FCS and below")
team_season <- tbl(con, "team_season") |>
  filter(season <= last_season, games_played > 0) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(tier_label = factor(tier_label, levels = tier_order))
teams <- tbl(con, "teams") |> collect()
picks <- tbl(con, "picks") |>
  filter(year >= 2014L, year <= last_season + 1L) |>
  collect()
# Each school's tier in its latest recorded season before the draft.
school_tier <- team_season |>
  filter(!is.na(tier_label)) |>
  transmute(
    collegeTeam = team,
    tier_season = season,
    tier = as.character(tier_label),
    conference
  )
window_picks <- picks |>
  left_join(
    school_tier,
    by = join_by(collegeTeam, closest(year > tier_season))
  ) |>
  mutate(tier = coalesce(tier, "School not in the data"))
n_window <- nrow(window_picks)
# Josh Allen (Wyoming, 2018), keyed on athlete id (picks has two Josh Allens).
allen_id <- "3918298"
allen <- filter(picks, playerId == allen_id, year == 2018L)
```

```{r}
#| label: compute
school_picks <- window_picks |>
  arrange(collegeTeam, year) |>
  group_by(team = collegeTeam) |>
  summarise(
    picks = n(),
    tier = last(tier),
    conference = last(conference),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(picks), team) |>
  mutate(rank = row_number(), cum_share = cumsum(picks) / sum(picks))
n_schools <- nrow(school_picks)
half_n <- which(school_picks$cum_share >= 0.5)[1]
wyo <- filter(school_picks, team == allen$collegeTeam)
wyo_color <- team_color_values(teams)[[allen$collegeTeam]]
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
top_schools <- filter(school_picks, rank <= half_n)
p <- ggplot(school_picks, aes(rank, cum_share)) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 1.3, color = "grey55") +
  geom_point_interactive(
    data = top_schools,
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        "#", rank, " ", team, ": ", picks, " picks (",
        scales::percent(cum_share, accuracy = 1), " cumulative)"
      ),
      data_id = team
    ),
    color = "#374151",
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Share of draft picks by school",
    subtitle = "Schools ranked by picks; dark points reach half",
    x = "Draft-day schools, ranked by draft picks",
    y = "Share of picks",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "school-draft-concentration", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: table
tibble::tibble(
  Schools = c(
    "Top 10",
    "Top 25",
    paste("Top", half_n),
    "Top 50",
    "Top 100",
    paste("All", n_schools, "draft-day schools")
  ),
  n = c(10L, 25L, half_n, 50L, 100L, n_schools)
) |>
  mutate(
    picks_n = cumsum(school_picks$picks)[n],
    share = school_picks$cum_share[n],
    `Draft picks` = fmt(picks_n),
    `Share of picks` = pct(share)
  ) |>
  select(Schools, `Draft picks`, `Share of picks`) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Schools", "Draft picks", "Share of picks"),
    caption = "Share of all draft picks in the classes of 2014 to 2026 from the draft-day schools with the most picks."
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: top-schools
top <- filter(school_picks, rank <= 60 | team == allen$collegeTeam) |>
  mutate(
    label = if_else(
      team == allen$collegeTeam,
      paste0(team, " (#", rank, ")"),
      team
    ),
    note = if_else(
      team == allen$collegeTeam,
      paste0(", including Josh Allen (", allen$year, ", pick ", allen$overall, ")"),
      ""
    )
  )
p_top <- ggplot(top, aes(picks, reorder(label, picks), fill = team)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        "#", rank, " ", team, " (", conference, ", ", tier, "): ",
        picks, " picks", note
      ),
      data_id = team
    ),
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_team(teams, guide = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Draft picks, classes of 2014 to 2026",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Draft picks by school, leaders and Wyoming",
    subtitle = "Team colors; the leaders plus Wyoming, where Josh Allen played; hover for the conference",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl(base_size = 12)
card_interactive(p_top)
```
